name: ADM Hamburg Aktiengesellschaft
summary: ADM Hamburg Aktiengesellschaft engages in the processing of soybeans and rapeseed. It also engages in the collection, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, semi-finished, and finished products. In addition, the company produces and sells biodiesel and pharmaceutical glycerine products. Further, it processes vegetable oils and fats. The company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. ADM Hamburg Aktiengesellschaft is a subsidiary of Archer-Daniels-Midland Company.
